newsitem.title: USA: United Auto to buy 3 Ford dealerships.
newsitem.headline: United Auto to buy 3 Ford dealerships.

text.p: United Auto Group Inc said on Thursday it has agreed to acquire 100 percent of the capital stock of three Ford Motor Co dealerships.
United Auto said it plans to buy Marshall Mize Ford Inc of Chattanooga, Tennessee, and Georgia-based Wade Ford Inc and Wade Ford Buford Inc.
The aggregate purchase price for the dealerships is $23.0 million, United Auto said. United Auto will pay $19.0 million in cash and $4.0 million in stock, the company said.

The company has also agreed to make an additional cash payment to the extent that the common stock issued in the transaction is valued at less than $4.0 million when the shares become freely tradeable, United Auto said.
The transaction is expected to close by mid-May 1997 and is subject to manufacturer approvals as well as other customary conditions, United Auto said.
The three dealerships had estimated 1996 revenues of approximately $200 million, United Auto said.
